name: qsmxt-bids
label: QSMxT
description: Runs Neurodesk QSMxT 9.x on an XNAT MR session. The session's DICOM scans are mounted directly and QSMxT converts them to BIDS internally (qsmxt dicom-convert) before running the QSM pipeline, so no pre-existing NIFTI or BIDS scan resources are required.

inputs.name: premade
inputs.label: Pipeline preset
inputs.description: OpenRecon presets override the custom algorithm controls. Legacy presets remain available for existing configurations.

inputs.name: qsm-algorithm
inputs.label: QSM algorithm
inputs.description: QSMxT inversion algorithm for the Custom pipeline preset. HD-QSM is the OpenRecon default for a fast reconstruction with good QSM-CI performance.

inputs.name: unwrapping-algorithm
inputs.label: Unwrap
inputs.description: QSMxT phase unwrapping algorithm. ROMEO is the recommended default for multi-echo QSM.

inputs.name: bf-algorithm
inputs.label: Background removal
inputs.description: QSMxT background-field removal algorithm for the Custom pipeline preset. iSMV is the OpenRecon default, paired with ROMEO and HD-QSM.

inputs.name: masking-input
inputs.label: Threshold input
inputs.description: Input used by Robust threshold and the threshold part of Combined. Magnitude is safer for single-echo acquisitions; phase quality is most useful with multiple echoes.

inputs.name: mask-preset
inputs.label: Mask preset
inputs.description: Brain mask for Custom and OpenRecon presets. Legacy presets retain their original masks.

inputs.name: do-swi
inputs.label: Generate SWI
inputs.description: Compute susceptibility-weighted images from magnitude and phase.

inputs.name: do-t2starmap
inputs.label: Generate T2* map
inputs.description: Quantitative relaxation time in seconds, distinct from T2starw magnitude. Requires at least three equally spaced magnitude echoes.

inputs.name: do-r2starmap
inputs.label: Generate R2* map
inputs.description: Quantitative relaxation rate in 1/s. Requires at least three equally spaced magnitude echoes. QSMxT computes T2* and R2* together when either is enabled.

outputs.name: qsmxt-output
outputs.description: QSMxT derivatives copied from the BIDS derivatives directory (derivatives/qsmxt/).

xnat.name: qsmxt-session
xnat.label: QSMxT
xnat.description: Run QSMxT on this MR session

external-inputs.name: session
external-inputs.description: Input MR session. Its DICOM scans are converted to BIDS inside the QSMxT container, so no pre-existing NIFTI/BIDS scan resources are needed. The session should contain multi-echo GRE (part-mag/part-phase) QSM series.
